About Fresh Bean Coffee Company

Fresh Bean Coffee Company's menu runs from espresso-based coffee and hot chocolate to freshly squeezed juices, milkshakes, slushes, dirty sodas and frezos.

Matcha and boba are on offer alongside the coffee.
